# Shared foundations

Numerical linear algebra, posterior diagnostics, scoring rules, deterministic
parallel mapping, validation helpers, and versioned reproduction data are
shared by both model engines.

```{r copy-core-utilities, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_dir <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "newly-written-and-modified-scripts"
)
package_r_dir <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R")
modules <- c("core_parallel.R", "core_numerics.R", "reproduction_data.R")
copied <- file.copy(
  file.path(source_dir, modules),
  file.path(package_r_dir, modules),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
stopifnot(all(copied))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(source_dir, modules))),
  unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(package_r_dir, modules)))
))
```
